For 0<a<=1 this is a Γ=S_m×C2 strong deformation onto the connected crown graph K_m,m minus its diagonal edges. Its signed cellular incidence e_ij↦B_j−A_i gives a free integral H1 of rank m(m−1)−2m+1=m²−3m+1; arm permutations relabel and particle swap reverses oriented e_ij to −e_ji. For 1<a<=2 all allowed ordered distinct-arm pairs form contractible radial triangles, deforming to m(m−1) isolated tip pairs; a>2 empty. Inclusions within regimes preserve the retraction models and crossing the threshold maps H0 by augmentation. The C1/C0 exact sequence yields χ(σ,0)=f²−3f+1 and χ(σ,1)=1−2t2; independent exact chain-level counts check 1,740 actions on m=3..6. Standard S_m modules on oriented/unoriented pair sets yield the even exterior-square standard module S^(m−2,1,1) and the odd kernel S^(m−2,2) (vanishes m=3). These arguments are uniform in m and positive real a; the finite group tests are corroboration.
